sloka: प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति ।प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति ॥२-२४-२९॥
transliteration: prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati ।prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati ॥2-24-29॥

translations.english: Looking forward to my return, spend your time this way with moderate intake, a mind under control and a life devoted to the service of your husband.
